[P2] Freeze context-held observations before cleanup

When a phase fails before collection and the adapter has no optional `collect_partial`, local `evidence` remains empty even if observations already exist in `context.evidence`. Retirement is then audited against an empty baseline; the fallback copy occurs only after releasing the lease. A retirement snapshot can therefore omit a known task or resource and still permit target reuse, while cleanup can overwrite the reported observations. Deep-copy retained context evidence before `release`/`retire` and use that frozen baseline for both auditing and reporting. Cover this early-failure path without `collect_partial`.
